title: The 5 Best-Selling Cars of All Time, Ranked (#1 Hits 50 Million)

scenes.text: The five best-selling cars ever. The Beetle and the Model T don't even make the list.

scenes.label: Honda Civic · 27M+
scenes.text: Number five: the Honda Civic. Over twenty-seven million sold since nineteen seventy-two, and still being built.

scenes.label: VW Passat · 30M+
scenes.text: Number four: the Volkswagen Passat. Volkswagen built its thirty millionth in twenty nineteen, and it's still going.

scenes.label: VW Golf · 35M+
scenes.text: Number three: the Volkswagen Golf. Over thirty-five million sold since nineteen seventy-four.

scenes.label: Ford F-Series · 42M+
scenes.text: Number two: the Ford F-Series pickup. Over forty-two million trucks sold since nineteen forty-eight.

scenes.label: Corolla · 50M
scenes.text: Number one: the Toyota Corolla. Fifty million sold since nineteen sixty-six, more than any other car in history.

description:
The five best-selling car nameplates ever, ranked by units sold.
The Beetle and the Model T are not on the list, and the winner passed 50 million sales.
Which car would you have bet on for number one?
first_comment: Which car did you expect at number one? And what should we rank next?
